General American Investors Company Stake in Paratek Pharmaceuticals (PRTK) Raised as Share Price Rose; As Chesapeake Energy (CHK) Share Price Declined, Pomelo Capital Has Decreased Its Stake 
January 6, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Philip Rosenstrach decreased its stake in Chesapeake Energy Corp (CHK) by 40.14% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pomelo Capital Llc sold 509,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.25% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by Philip Rosenstrach held 760,500 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.27M, down from 1.27 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pomelo Capital Llc who had been investing in Chesapeake Energy Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.57B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.48% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $3.99. About 33.66 million shares traded or 31.14% up from the average. Chesapeake Energy Corporation (NYSE:CHK) has risen 49.74% since January 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.04% the S&P500. 
General American Investors Company Inc increased its stake in Paratek Pharmaceuticals Inc. (PRTK) by 13.02% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. General American Investors Company Inc bought 40,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 33.85% with the market. The institutional investor held 347,213 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $8.72M, up from 307,213 at the end of the previous reported quarter. General American Investors Company Inc who had been investing in Paratek Pharmaceuticals Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $524.59 million market cap company. The stock decreased 0.40% or $0.075 during the last trading session, reaching $18.775. About 264,161 shares traded. Paratek Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:PRTK) has risen 62.03% since January 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.33% the S&P500. 
Pomelo Capital Llc, which manages about $366.34M and $2.35 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Valeant Pharmaceuticals Intl (Put) (NYSE:VRX) by 827,100 shares to 1.05M shares, valued at $15.01M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Navistar Intl Corp New (Put) (NYSE:NAV) by 5.22 million shares in the quarter, for a total of 5.25M shares, and has risen its stake in Weight Watchers Intl Inc New (Put) (NYSE:WTW).
